tools.name: plan_dive
tools.description: Computes the decompression plan for one dive, open circuit (OC) or closed-circuit rebreather (CCR): stop table, runtime, time to surface (TTS), gas used per cylinder, ascent pressure, CNS/OTU, gas density, warnings, contingencies, CCR bailout and a Dive Kit share link. Defaults unless given: GF 50/8

tools.name: find_max_bottom_time
tools.description: Finds the longest whole-minute bottom time on one level of an open-circuit plan: the longest that keeps every cylinder at or above its reserve (limit reserve), whose time to surface fits a budget (limit tts), or that needs no stop (limit no_deco). tools.name: check_no_deco
tools.description: Use this when the diver asks how long they can stay at a depth without decompression stops (no-deco limit, NDL, no-stop time). findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "lookup_references" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
